content.comment_body: Can you explain this program? I don't understand the functions X and S.

Hello, X serves as an open connector for the shift register output and shouldn't be left disconnected from a block's outputs. S denotes the shift register bits, which are managed by the shift register block. Additional details are available in the online help or in the manual, specifically chapter 4-4-27. Regards,
